m: निल् cl. 6. P. निलति, to understand with difficulty; to be impassable or impenetrable, Dhātup. xxviii, 68.
निलाम्भोज n. id., Subh.
नि-˚लाय m. place of refuge, AV. iv, 16, 2.
नि-˚लायन n. hiding one's self
नि-˚लायन—क्रीडा f. playing at hide and seek, BhP.
नि-˚लायिन् mfn. descending or alighting in, inhabiting (comp.), Śiś.
नि-˚लायि-ता f., ib.

नि-√ ली Ā. -लीयते (rarely P., e.g. Pot. -लीयेत्), MBh. &c. or -लयते, RV.; AV. (cf. नि-री; impf. -अलायत, TS.; pf. -लिल्ये, 3. pl. ˚यिरे, or ˚युर्, Br.; aor. -अलेष्ट, Br.; 3. pl. -अलेषत, Bhaṭṭ.; ind.p. -लाय, TBr.; -लीय, Hariv.; inf. -लेतुम्, Śiś.); to settle down (esp. applied to the alighting of birds), alight, descend, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to become settled or fixed, Rājat. iii, 426; to hide one's self, conceal one's self from (abl.), disappear, perish, RV.; &c.
a: निली — {c4c} A. 1 To stick or adhere to, lie or rest upon, settle down or alight upon; निलिल्ये मूर्ध्न गृध्रोऽस्य Bk. 14. 76; 2. 5. --2 To lurk or hide, hide oneself in; गुहास्वन्ये न्यलेषत Bk. 15. 32; निशि रहसि निलीय Gīt. 2. --3 To hide or conceal oneself from (with abl.); मातुर्निलीयते कृष्णः Sk. --4 To die, perish.

s: tri, (niHSezeRa lInaM saMlagnam । ni + lI + ktaH .) niHSezeRa lInam । saMlagnam । (yaTA, BawwiH । 2 । 5 । “vanAni toyAni ca netrakalpEH puzpEH sarojESca nilInaBfNgEH । parasparaM vismayavanti lakzmImAlokayAYcakrurivAdareRa ॥”
v: tri॰ nitarAM lInaH । atyantasambadDe tasyAdUradeSAdi fSyAdi॰ ka । nilInaka tatsannikfzwadeSAdO tri॰
m: नि-˚लीन mfn. (नि-) clinging to, sitting on, hidden in (loc. or comp.), AV.; Var.; Kāv. &c.
quite intent upon or devoted to (loc.), Bhartṛ. (v.l. विल्˚)
resorted to, sought for shelter by (instr.), R.
fused into, involved, encompassed, wrapt up, W.
destroyed, perished, ib.
transformed, changed, ib.
a: निलीन — p. p. 1 Melted or fused into. --2 Shut or wrapt up, hidden into. --3 Involved, surrounded, encompassed. --4 Destroyed, perished. --5 Changed, transformed. --6 Full.

m: नि-˚लीनक mfn. shrunk up (while being cooked, as milk), Pat. (cf. g. ऋश्यादि)
नि-˚लीनक m. or n. (?) N. of a village in the north country (cf. नैलीनक).
नि-˚लीयमान mfn. hiding, lying concealed in (loc.), BhP.
निलङ्गु m. a species of worm, TS. (v.l. for नील्˚).
निलय् ˚यते; perf. नि-लयां चक्रे, ŚBr. See निर्-√ इ.

s: puM, (nilIyate asminniti । ni + lI + “erac .” 3 । 3 । 66 । iti aDikaraRe ac .) gfham । ityamaraH । 2 । 2 । 5 ॥ (yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 2 । 15 । “saYcArapUtAni digantarARi kftvA dinAnte nilayAya gantum ॥” ASrayasTAnam । yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 1 । 11 । “taM BUtanilayaM devaM suparRamupaDAvata ॥”)
v: pu॰ nilIyate'tra lI--ADAre ac । 1 gfhe 2 AvAsasTAne ca amaraH । “nilayaH SriyaH satatametaditi” mAGaH । 3 niHSezeRa laye 4 adarSane । uBayatra “saYcArapUtAni digantarARi kftvA dinAnte nilayAya gantum । pracakrame pallavarAgatAmrA praBA pataNgasya muneSca DenuH” raGuH ।
m: नि-लय &c. See नि-ली.
नि-˚लय m. rest, resting-place (cf. अ-निल्˚)
hiding- or dwelling-place, den, lair, nest
house, residence, abode (often ifc. [f(आ). ] = living in, inhabiting, inhabited by), MBh.; Var.; Kāv. &c.
a: निलयः — 1 A hiding place, the lair or den of animals, a nest (of birds); Śi. 9. 4. --2 An abode, residence, house, dwelling; oft. at the end of comp. in the sense of ‘living or residing in’. --3 Hiding oneself. --4 Total destruction. --5 Setting, disappearance; दिनांते निलयाय गंतुं R. 2. 15 (where the word is used in sense 1 also).

k.v: निशान्तवस्त्यसदनं भवनागारमन्दिरम्. गृहाः पुंसि च भूम्न्येव निकाय्यनिलयालयाः॥

v: na॰ nilIyate'tra ni + lI ADAre lyuw । nIqAdAvASraye । “nilayanaYcAnilayanaYca” tEtti॰ upa॰ “nilayanaM nIqamASrayo mUrttasyEva DarmaH” BA॰ । “vihvalaM tat samudrABaM saBayaM BAratAturam । balamAsIt tadA sarvamfte droRArjunAvuBO । tAvevAstAM nilayanaM tAvArttAyanameva ca” BA॰ dro॰ 188 a॰ । BAve lyuw । 2 SlezaRe sambanDe “uttamANge nilayanaM kapotakaNkapraBftInAm” suSru॰ ।
m: निलयन n. the act of going out, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 46, Sch. (prob. ident. with 2. नि-ल्˚ below).
2. नि-˚लयन n. settling down, alighting in or on (loc.), Var.; Suśr.
hiding-place &c. = prec. TBr.; MBh. &c.
a: निलयनं — 1 Settling in a place, alighting. --2 A place of refuge house, dwelling, habitation. --3 The act of going out.

m: नि-˚लय—सुन्दर m. N. of a man, Cat.

a: निलिंपः — 1 A god; निलिंपैर्निमुक्तानपि च निरयांतर्निपतितान् G. L. 15. --2 A troop of Maruts. --Comp. --निर्झरी the celestial Ganges.

a milk-pail, Gal.

नि-√ लुप् (only ind.p. -लोपम्, robbing), prob. w.r. for निर्-लुप्, L.
